title: Findify pricing - Tiered from $499 to $1,199/month
clean_text: Findify's entry plan starts at $499 per month for up to 20,000 products in one store and language, without personalized recommendations. The Professional tier costs $799 per month, supporting up to 100,000 visits and 50,000 products with multiple stores and languages, but still without the recommendations feature. The Enterprise tier at $1,199 per month adds Personalized Recommendations along with custom visit and product limits and full account management support. A 14-day free trial is available across all tiers.
